title: Chapter 153: Invincible Cavalry
content:
Chapter 153: Invincible Cavalry

The leader of the bear goblin earth dragon cavalry led out the spare earth dragon mount and gave it to the evil god high priest and ordinary priests to ride. The priests' mounts had long disappeared in the explosion.

Riding on the fierce earth dragon, the evil god high priest tidied his appearance and regained his calm state.

The explosion caused by the Zerg could not be resisted by human power. They survived because of the power of the evil god.

He did not think too much about things that could not be done by human power. The faith in his heart made him only want to restore some dignity for the spirit god and let the Zerg know that the spirit god could not be blasphemed!

As for the excuse of keeping a useful body and going back to report the news, it was no longer needed. Their failure was the most useful information. As for how they failed, the spirit god did not care at all.

The bear goblin ground dragon cavalry, led by the evil god's high priest, climbed out from the bottom of the pit on the ground dragon, facing the direction of the Zerg army, and lined up, waiting for the high priest's order to launch a charge!

...

The Zerg army that entered the city has already annihilated all the 5,000 powerful enemies of the evil god's army.

Many buildings near the center of the explosion collapsed, and the ground was full of ruins of buildings.

The Zerg puppies gathered in front of the bear goblin ground dragon cavalry that had formed a charge formation. Wu Qing was ready to use the Zerg puppies to withstand the charge of this powerful cavalry of a thousand people!

Attack against attack, use quantity to stop the enemy's high-quality assault!

As long as the enemy does not turn around and run away, the Zerg will not rush to besiege them.

The Zerg Hydralisk, led by two thousand one-star Hydralisks, occupied various commanding heights, and they are still the main force of the Zerg's attack output.

If the Zerg puppies directly besiege the enemy, with their siege method, the Zerg Hydralisk can only watch.

The High Priest of the Evil God rode a ground dragon to the front of the formation, raised his hand and waved forward. The strong bear goblin ground dragon cavalry, who were as strong as giant bears, wore heavy armor, carried silver wolf-tooth clubs, rode fierce ground dragons, rushed past the High Priest, and rumbled towards the direction of the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg puppies were not to be outdone, all bared their teeth and claws, ready to rush out to fight at any time!

The distance between the two sides was rapidly approaching, and the bear goblin cavalry, who were charging at high speed, all picked up the metal chain hammer hanging behind them. This is a throwing weapon with a hammer tied to one end of the iron chain. In the hands of professional throwers, the long-range attack is extremely powerful!

The Zerg puppies are still waiting. They need to wait for the enemy to get closer and try to put the enemy within the best range of the Zerg Hydralisk.

The bear goblin cavalry rushed out of the area near the square, stepped on the ruins on the ground, and continued to charge forward. They will soon rush into the street area with many buildings!

The terrain adaptability of the ground dragons is also very strong, and such an environment cannot affect their charge.

As if they were in sync, the Zerg Hydralisk, Zerg Hounds and Bugbear Cavalry attacked at the same time!

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid sprayed by the Zerg Hydralisk splashed on the charging Bugbear Ground Dragoons like water!

If these Bugbear Cavalry did not have the energy protection shield blessed by the evil god to protect themselves, facing such an attack, their weapons and equipment, their mounts and themselves would be damaged by the Zerg biological decomposition liquid.

The Zerg Hounds moved and took the initiative to charge at the rumbling Bugbear Ground Dragoons!

The metal chain hammers held high in the hands of the Bugbear Ground Dragoons swung several circles above their heads and then swung towards the area with the most Zerg Hounds!

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid that fell like a torrential rain fell on the Bugbear Ground Dragoons, and was all blocked by an invisible energy. Even the Bugbear Ground Dragoons under them were protected by this energy!

The evil god's high priest and ordinary priests who followed them in the charge also had such energy shields on their bodies!

The Zerg Hydralisk's biodegradation liquid attack was ineffective!

The metal chain hammers thrown by the bear goblin ground dragon cavalry were attached with the energy of the evil god, like a meat grinder, and flew into the Zerg puppies at high speed!

Blood and flesh flew everywhere! The Zerg puppies disappeared piece by piece!

Nearly a thousand metal chain hammers! They flew all the way into the depths of the Zerg puppy dense area before they fell to the ground with all their strength!

This is the most efficient weapon for killing Zerg puppies! If it was just this kind of weapon, of course it wouldn't be so terrible! What's terrible is the energy of the evil god attached to the weapon!

With the blessing of this evil god's energy, the metal chain hammer is almost indestructible!

And this weapon is a long-range weapon for area killing. They are just the best combination, which has caused such a terrible killing effect!

It can be said that if you rub it, you will die if you touch it. Nothing can stop it!

Wu Qing found that the nearly 1,000 bear goblin ground dragon cavalry and evil god priests were in the strongest blessing state, so he silently dispatched 100,000 Zerg puppies into the city again.

The bear goblin ground dragon cavalry, which was originally very powerful, had the terrifying blessing of the evil god, plus the cooperation of the evil god priests. If Wu Qing didn't send more Zerg puppies to such a cavalry unit, he felt a little unsafe!

The evil god priests sitting silently on the ground dragon mounts were all silently reciting prayers. They raised their hands and fired a very fast white light ball, which flew into the Zerg puppies rushing up, and exploded violently, disrupting the Zerg puppies' charging formation!

"Boom... Boom... Boom...!"

Explosion, high temperature, energy shock! Disrupted the Zerg puppies' charge!

The armor-piercing spikes of the Zerg Hydralisks shot over densely, hitting the energy shields of the Bugbear Dragoons and the Evil God Priests, and flew everywhere!

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

The Zerg puppies whose formation was disrupted continued to charge, and the tall and strong ground dragons, wearing the Evil God's energy shield, slammed into the Zerg puppies that rushed up, ignoring the various attacks of the Zerg puppies and rushing all the way!

The Bugbear Cavalry riding on the back of the ground dragon, holding a silver mace suitable for cavalry warfare, under the blessing of the evil god's energy, with one stick, the Zerg puppies that touched and touched, all had their shells shattered, and instantly turned into light and disappeared!

The combat power of these Bugbear Cavalry is comparable to that of three-star troops, and they are blessed with the indestructible evil god's energy. With the powerful ground dragon mounts under their seats, it is not a problem for one person to fight dozens of ordinary Zerg puppies alone!

Break through!

The charge team of less than a thousand bear goblins, like a chisel, chiseled into the dense formation of the Zerg puppies!

The Zerg puppies moved very quickly, and a large number of puppies rushed up from the back at once, filling the sparse front offensive formation!

At this time, the bear goblin dragoons had already rushed to the street area, and there were a large number of buildings in front, and all kinds of buildings were crawling with Zerg puppies.

The bear goblin dragoons did not slow down or turn! The buildings blocking the road in front were hit by the dragons and collapsed one after another. The goblin cavalry smashed the Zerg puppies in front and the surrounding buildings with the sticks in their hands!

Nothing can stop the bear goblin dragoons who are charging at this moment!

Wearing invincible armor! Indestructible!

The evil god army has less than a thousand people, and the target is very small. Most of the Zerg hydralisks cannot attack effectively, and it is difficult to speed up their consumption!

"Except for two thousand one-star Hydralisks, all other Hydralisks should withdraw from the city!"

"Zerg Zerglings will slowly consume them! See how long those blessed states can last!"

Wu Qing gave the Queen an order.

The Queen commanded the Hydralisks to retreat, making room for more Zerg Zerglings to enter the city and gather towards the battlefield.

Two thousand one-star Hydralisks are responsible for long-range output to consume the enemy's blessed state. Their attacks are accurate and fierce, and still have a certain effect.

Facing the continuous attacks of the one-star Hydralisks, some cavalrymen in the Goblin Dragoon team wanted to counterattack with metal chain hammers, and the evil god priests also wanted to attack with energy balls.

But the one-star Hydralisks scattered on the commanding heights around will use their agility to actively avoid these attacks.

With Zerg hosts monitoring the battlefield, every detail on the battlefield can be seen clearly. As long as the enemy intends to attack the one-star Hydralisks, the one-star Hydralisks will take the initiative to dodge!

The Zerg puppies kept rushing forward, almost unable to touch the Bugbear Dragoons. The Dragoons were rampaging, with great strength and invincible defense!

The Bugbear Cavalry's maces swung left and right, as if there was infinite power supporting their high-intensity battle!

The Zerg originally wanted to fight a frontal blocking battle to create more attack opportunities for the Zerg Hydralisk, but the Zerg puppies could not stop the enemy's attack at all. Now the enemy directly rushed into the Zerg formation, and the Zerg could only rely on the puppies to fight the encirclement battle alone!

Around the Bugbear Dragoons, countless Zerg puppies rushed up from all directions, trying to drown them!

They took out their limited metal chain hammers and threw them at the Zerg puppies rushing around. This weapon caused large-scale casualties to the Zerg puppies that were crowded together and charging!

The evil god priests no longer saved energy. Their explosive energy balls were continuously fired in all directions, and there were constant explosions among the Zerg puppies rushing up!

Under these two powerful area-killing attacks, the Zerg Puppies suffered heavy casualties, and it was difficult to quickly encircle the Bugbear Dragoon team!

More Zerg Puppies rushed up!

Using the number of Zerg Puppies to consume the area-killing attacks of the evil god army, the Bugbear Dragoon carried a small number of metal chain hammers, and the energy used by the evil god priests was also limited.

The Bugbear Dragoon continued to charge forward and had already rushed to the center of the Zerg Puppy assembly area. Zerg Puppies kept rushing up from all directions!

The metal chain hammers of the Bugbear Dragoon were finally exhausted. Without their long-range large-scale killing, the attacks of a small number of evil god priests alone could no longer stop the Zerg Puppies from encircling!

The black mass of Zerg Puppies rushed up, and the Bugbear Dragoon behind the evil god army had to turn around and attack. The unstoppable Bugbear Dragoon finally slowed down its charge!
